note: Township campground on Croton Dam Pond, the 1,380-acre Muskegon River impoundment above Croton Dam, at 7683 S Croton Hardy Dr, Newaygo: waterfront and wooded lots, two boat launches, dock rentals, a small sandy beach. Walking distance to restaurants, stores and gas. --Claude
summary: Township site: 2025 rates $30 (wooded) to $50 (waterfront, holiday), one rate for everyone (new); electric at every site, water fill near sites, dump (confirmed); bathhouses, laundry, camp store (new); 'over 150' sites; reservable online through the site's own booking window or by phone (platform phone -> operator). Season year_round:false (derived from note prose 'Open ~Apr 15 - Oct 15') cleared: the site posts no season and says 'Limited winter camping available'. Amperage (20 A) and 36-ft max not stated by the site, left. Phone matches. Seasonal sites exist with a waiting list; the site does not give their share, but every lot type has daily, weekend and holiday rates and online booking, so it reads as nightly in character. Note trimmed of field restatements and the unsupported season.
